coverage_notes.summary: Twelve targeted searches covered loss of an only/sole/last/full-service grocery store, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure/access reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruptions. No new U.S. event in the bounded hourly window met the qualifying criteria.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official agency/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
exclusions_observed: Only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store results were older events, reopenings, planned closures, or non-window items.
Emergency food-distribution searches surfaced preparedness, recovery activity, routine operations, or older weather disruptions rather than a new cancellation or suspension.
Pantry and food-bank searches did not surface a new abrupt U.S. closure or major access reduction in the bounded window.
SNAP/WIC/food-assistance searches primarily surfaced older shutdown-era or policy-change coverage, not a new official interruption with immediate access consequences.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is non-authoritative; production collection remains authoritative.
